The test image shows a banana leaf with:
- Green healthy interior
- A distinct yellow band along the leaf margin (right edge)
- Brown/necrotic tissue at the very edge
- Irregular scalloped boundary between yellow and green

This is the classic presentation of **Panama Disease** (Fusarium wilt) — yellowing initiates at the leaf margins and progresses inward, with brown necrosis at the leading edge. The Panama Disease reference (Banana_Leaf_1006) showed a more advanced stage with the entire leaf yellowed, but the same yellow-to-brown progression pattern is consistent.
